steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Pray watch me from here.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Ahead lies the pack of Escorchgot. Allow me to handle them this time.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...You really don't need our help?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: If I cannot handle even this trifle, how could I challenge the Lord of Thunder?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Gotta be honest, this is all going way over my head.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did we seriously get dragged into a story straight out of one of Spot's comics?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Let's not jump to any conclusions.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A trial, an 'Iju', and 'Iju Hunters' every ten years. Not to mention that 'Gyorin' thing that sticks out like a sore thumb... It all feels a little deliberate, don't you think?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And then there's Popukar—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So you're saying someone's trying to pull a fast one on us?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You haven't forgotten that we were in Sargon before all this, right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Some of the local padishahs have far too much time and money on their hands. Maybe one of them built a film studio around an oasis somewhere.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wow, living that kind of high life doesn't sound too bad—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wait, if that's the case, that means I'm living it right now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But how do you explain those three?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A padishah can easily have people with extraordinary powers in their employ. Maybe they've been brainwashed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But why them? Why us?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How should I know? I'm just saying it's possible.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And if I'm right, at least they're safe.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But if I'm not—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Say, Orchid... Don't you think this guy looks kinda... familiar?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...A giant Originium slug?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, yeah. You know what, I think I'm warming up to your film studio theory!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I mean, this can't be a coincidence! There's definitely something wrong going on here!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We need a plan.

steps.name: Escorchgot
steps.text: (Loud screech)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, I think it wants to sit in on our strategy meeting.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Your umbrella still on the fritz?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Looks like it... What the heck is wrong with this thing?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't engage! It's slow and not very intelligent!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Make use of the terrain! Draw it into the bamboo grove over there!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, big guy! Over here!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Now! Drop all that bamboo on top of it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, burying it actually worked!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's not over just yet. It's getting loose! Look, its magma shell is burning away the bamboo!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa! I think it's really mad! It's looking right at us!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Split up! It's about to spit fire at us!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Gah, there's nowhere to hide! Its range is stupid wide!
In this moment of desperation, they hear a sound from nearby. A roar that splits the heavens.
A hulking, cyan beast lithely emerges from amidst the bamboo stalks.
The stalks topple like toy blocks, as if they are bowing towards their rightful lord, as if they are trying to escape some fell demon.
Time freezes the moment the moon's light shines upon it. Even the hearts of those who gaze upon it seem to have stopped beating.
Its horns are akin to a crown, gleaming coldly under the moonlight.
Its body is a jewel draped in night, each movement of its muscles emitting a shower of white light, as if an entire storm were trapped beneath its scales, struggling to break free.
The earth trembles as it strides forward. Arcs of lightning connect its claws to any rocks they touch. With every sweep of its tail, sparks fly, like the sickle moon tearing apart the night.
The Escorchgot that was causing the pair so much trouble looks positively adorable compared to this.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What... What is that? Doesn't look like any animal I've ever seen—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is... Is that the Lord of Thunder?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It took out that giant Originium slug in one swipe...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It's looking right at us. I'll—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't be stupid!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, 'Lord of Thunder'! Take this!

steps.name: Lord of Thunder
steps.text: (Low roar)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...No way! That didn't even scratch it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Gah... I can't use my Arts, but I can at least—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're too reckless, Catapult!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did you just chuck a dung bomb at it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I picked up a few while we were running away. Popukar said they were great at driving away beasts, and I decided better safe than sorry.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's our Orchid!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But man, that Lord of Thunder... It's one hell of a beast.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't even think about rushing in without a gameplan next time. Got it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Fiiine.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: My friends! I heard the cry of the Lord of Thunder,

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: are ye—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err, haha.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We had a little tussle with it just now.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Reckless, far too reckless!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeah, I already got an earful of that from Orchid.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thank the gods you are safe...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I have cleared out the Escorchgot in the area.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Any trace of the Iju?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...None.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are Escorchgot native to this place, Hofukaru?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Of course. They have always resided in the borderlands of Houei.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: They look like they'd be more at home in a volcano than a forest, though?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: It is only natural for you to be unaware. Though the mountain under the Gyorin is capped in snow, magma lies beneath its peaks.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Therein lies their natural habitat.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: May we begin the clean-up, Your Majesty?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: It is safe now. Thou mayest proceed.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: I knew you could do it, Your Majesty!

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: I thank the Gyorin's favor, and the miko's guidance. We, the people of Houei, are honored to receive these gifts from the gods.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: Retrieve the Escorchgot corpses, and gather all useful materials.

steps.name: Samurai Attendants
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err... What're they doing?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Escorchgot normally remain in their natural habitat, and rarely appear in numbers elsewhere. Their shells can be made into long-burning Escarcoal.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: Her Majesty is right! Escarcoal is sturdy and high quality, but Escorchgot are far too rare a sight. Our haul today will ensure we need not worry about the cold come winter.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Okay, but why are those guys over there happily chopping down bamboo?

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: We use bamboo for many things, and Escorchgot can reach temperatures far higher than our largest kilns. They allow us to heat bamboo until it becomes harder than rock.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: This treated bamboo, we call Blisterstalk.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: It can be fashioned into both weapons and furniture, all incredibly durable.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sounds cool! I'll help you guys out!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...So you can only get these things through the trial?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Every decade's trial and the Iju it brings induce profound changes in the environment.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Though it is a time of great danger, it is also when we can obtain that which we normally cannot.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This is why Houei sees the trial as both crisis and opportunity.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'O'er hunts of beasts shall we preside, heaven's gifts shall be our guide.' This is the way of Houei.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Treating the outcome of the trial as a gift, even structuring their whole lives around it... this system is far too unstable.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh? This Blisterstalk stuff is great! Should be able to make some real stable ammo out of it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Have they never considered looking into the root cause of all this?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The cause is all these plants the Escorchgot burnt. Some of it actually smells pretty good.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're not listening to a word I'm saying!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yes I am.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...I don't believe their sob story. We need to come up with a way to find out what's really going on here.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Honestly, I don't see the problem?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You can stay here forever, then.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I mean, I'm not saying I believe them, I just don't think their way of life is as weird as you said.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Though I guess the Originium slugs are kind of a plot hole.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Look, if this really is a giant film set or a Padishah's flower garden or whatever, we're still gonna need to get those three before we leave, right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I know. We'll split up for now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll gather intelligence. You're quicker on your feet, so you investigate what happened to them.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now that's what I'm talking about!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Remember, your priority is to find clues, not to get yourself in trouble. Our ultimate goal is to rescue our teammates and get out of here together.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Roger that!
